```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<article><h2>Article Title</h2><p>Article body.</p></article>", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
